name: Boundary fix bench and chat
command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@raspberrypi.tailf63b31.ts.net 'cd ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/asm && S2=$(echo ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--google--gemma-3-270m-it-qat-q4_0-unquantized/snapshots/*/model.safetensors) && timeout 120 ./core $S2 ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/vocab.bin > /tmp/b1.log 2>&1; echo "BENCH-EXIT=$?"; grep -a "text:" -A3 /tmp/b1.log | head -4 | cut -c1-60; grep -a "METRIC" /tmp/b1.log | head -1; printf "Hello\n" | timeout 120 ./core $S2 ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/vocab.bin 2 c ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/bpe.bin 800 950 40 > /tmp/c1.log 2>&1; echo CHAT-EXIT=$?; awk "/chat ready/{f=1} f" /tmp/c1.log | tail -n +3 | head -6 | cut -c1-58'
